name: object-speeds
description: A microservice processing OSEF tracked-object data—object IDs, classes & names; kinematics (speed vectors & norms); 3D & SLAM poses; bounding-box sizes, footprints & vertices;  and metadata (properties, age, peak heights, matching pairs, confidence). The service reads a KAFKA stream of OSEF data from LiDAR sensors and produces a KAFKA stream of tracked-object OSEF data.

required_env_vars.name: KAFKA_SOURCE_BOOTSTRAP_SERVER
required_env_vars.description: Source Kafka bootstrap server in the format `host:port`. This is the server from which the service will consume messages.

required_env_vars.name: KAFKA_DEST_BOOTSTRAP_SERVER
required_env_vars.description: Destination Kafka bootstrap server in the format `host:port`. This is the server to which the service will produce messages.

required_env_vars.name: KAFKA_SCHEMA_REGISTRY_URL
required_env_vars.description: URL of the Schema Registry for Kafka.

optional_env_vars.name: OBJECT_TYPE_FILTER
optional_env_vars.description: List of object class names or IDs (as strings) to keep. Numeric entries are treated as class IDs; non-numeric entries are treated as class names. If empty, all object types are processed.

optional_env_vars.name: MAX_SOURCE_EMPTY_POLLS
optional_env_vars.description: Maximum number of empty polls before timing out.

optional_env_vars.name: SOURCE_AUTO_OFFSET_RESET
optional_env_vars.description: Where to start consuming messages if no committed offsets are found. Options are 'earliest' or 'latest'.

optional_env_vars.name: STRIDE
optional_env_vars.description: Stride for processing the KAFKA stream of OSEF data. Set to 1 to process every message. Stride of 2 will process every second message.

frozen_env_vars.name: KAFKA_CONSUMER_GROUP_ID
frozen_env_vars.description: Consumer group ID for the Kafka consumer.

frozen_env_vars.name: KAFKA_SOURCE_TOPIC
frozen_env_vars.description: Name of the Kafka topic to consume messages from.

frozen_env_vars.name: KAFKA_SOURCE_SCHEMA_VALUE_SUBJECT
frozen_env_vars.description: Name of the schema value subject to use for the source topic.

frozen_env_vars.name: KAFKA_DEST_TOPIC
frozen_env_vars.description: Name of the Kafka topic to produce messages to.

frozen_env_vars.name: KAFKA_DEST_SCHEMA_VALUE_SUBJECT
frozen_env_vars.description: Name of the schema value subject to use for the destination topic. This should match the schema file name in the schemas directory.
